item.title: 【UPSCALED】Eminem - The Way I Am (ALAC - Upscale 4K) (updated 2026)
item.description:
I actually have the SD ProRes master for this one, but the VOB looked better. I cut this one shot by shot between 24 fps and 60 fps segments, which means that, even though I reconstructed the grain (also shot by shot), the grain won't move if a frame is duplicated. I decided to keep it at 60 fps, but the frame rate of this one is all over the place: when Eminem is falling from the building, we have, at the same time, (1) a 24 fps shot of him singing, (2) a 30 fps VFX from the building moving past him, and (3) 60 fps position keyframes moving him across the frame, all in the SAME SHOT. But I kept it all, so it can be viewed as intended for television at the time, but in 4K, of course
